_about: Payer playbook 'what changed' feed, per-plan cards and the Analytics demo numbers for the Community Counseling Center of Southern Nevada (Nevada, adult SUD / ASAM) demo. Synthetic. Payer ids are the internal ones (humana = SilverSummit, anthem = Anthem, sentara = Molina, aetna = CareSource, uhc = HPN, ffs = Nevada Medicaid FFS).

policy_changes.from: 2 denials since Oct 20 · same reviewer initials
policy_changes.change: A new Anthem reviewer is denying mental-health therapy codes (90834, 90837) because the agency's provider type reads Substance Use Agency Model (SUAM).
policy_changes.effect: S. Lane's (LCPC) therapy sessions for E.C. denied as 'provider type not eligible'. The agency is enrolled for both SUD and mental health.
policy_changes.action: Psyflo drafts the reconsideration citing the Nevada Medicaid enrollment (PT 17 / Specialty 215 · confirm), attaches the enrollment letter, and puts one line about the enrollment at the top of every Anthem mental-health request.

policy_changes.change: Molina denies Level 2.1 continued stay as 'no longer meets medical necessity' when the client has been abstinent inside the IOP.
policy_changes.effect: Clients are stepped down before step-down criteria are met; T.N.'s denial goes to a peer-to-peer with the plan medical director.
policy_changes.action: Psyflo's Molina continued-stay draft leads with Dimension 5: relapse risk stays high without the Level 2.1 structure, with dated UDS results, D4 and D6 status, and why step-down criteria are not met yet. Peer-to-peer notes are prepared from the same facts.

policy_changes.change: SilverSummit denies Level 2.1 initial requests that do not include urine drug screen results from the assessment. It is not on SilverSummit's PA form, and SilverSummit does not pay for the test (H0048 / 80305).
policy_changes.effect: 3 initial requests denied and resubmitted; IOP days between denial and approval cannot be billed (no backdating).
policy_changes.action: Psyflo blocks the SilverSummit Level 2.1 packet until a UDS result dated at the assessment is attached, and lists it on the cover sheet.

policy_changes.from: 1 information request + 1 reply from the UM nurse, Oct 14
policy_changes.change: CareSource wants the six ASAM dimension ratings on page 1 of its own PA form, not only in the attached assessment.
policy_changes.effect: Requests with the ratings only in the attachment get an information request and lose 2–4 days.
policy_changes.action: Psyflo fills the D1–D6 ratings on page 1 of the CareSource form from the ASAM assessment before it goes for signature.

policy_changes.from: 2 claim denials + provider rep reply, Oct 7
policy_changes.change: Health Plan of Nevada is requiring prior authorization for Level 1 outpatient before session 24. It is not applying the Nevada Medicaid 24-session no-PA rule.
policy_changes.effect: Level 1 sessions billed without an auth were denied 'no authorization on file'.
policy_changes.action: Psyflo flags HPN Level 1 clients at intake and drafts the PA before the first session; denied sessions go to Denial Intelligence for reconsideration.

policy_changes.from: 4 decisions since Sep 8 authorized 5 sessions on 72-unit asks
policy_changes.change: Molina authorizes Level 2.1 IOP 5 sessions at a time instead of the full request.
policy_changes.effect: At 3 days a week, 5 sessions last under two weeks; a request that goes in late leaves IOP days unbillable.
policy_changes.action: Psyflo auto-drafts the next Molina request at session 3 and puts it on Do next for the clinician to sign, so it is in before session 5.
